The host returns to Ivanka Trump's account of "discovering" Sazan Island off the coast of Albania. She says the boat Ivanka jumped off was Nat Rothschild's superyacht Planet Nine and describes its helicopters, elevators and other features (A-2637.1). She then plays a Jared Kushner interview (A-2636.2) in which he says that in summer 2021 he and Ivanka were on "our friend Nat Rothschild's boat" and that Albania's Prime Minister Rama came aboard. The host links the island to strategic control of waterways. She reads Enver Hoxha's account of Nikita Khrushchev's 1959 remark that a fleet based at Sazan could control "the whole of the Mediterranean" (A-2638.1). She ties this to Donald Trump's Fox and Friends remarks that his "preference has always been take Kharg Island" and that Venezuelan oil had been brought to the United States (A-2639.1). The host says the Venezuelan oil was shipped to Israel.

In the second segment the host plays Pete Hegseth's CENTCOM press remarks in Tampa, in which he says the United States "will be hitting Iran hard" that night (A-2640.1). She shows images of his runs with troops around the world (A-2640.2) and says he went to Guantanamo Bay with Laura Loomer, who asked as a Pentagon reporter how long an operation to remove Cuba's government would take (A-2640.4). The host repeatedly misnames Hegseth "Pete Buttigieg" and calls Loomer "Larry Loomer" in a running bit. She then reads a Spectator US article headlined "Bombing Iran is the perfect way to celebrate pride" (A-2641.1).

The host plays a Charlie Kirk Show clip in which Andrew Kolvet and Blake Neff say Turning Point USA released the video of Charlie Kirk appointing Erika Kirk at YWLS to "troll the trolls" (A-2642.1, A-2642.2). The host maintains the video is doctored, says the video is from the Aspen donor event rather than ActCon, and asks Kolvet to state that it has not been altered with AI tools. In the comments she reads viewer notes from Albanians on their prime minister and a Haaretz article on Albania as a possible Jewish state (A-2644.1). She closes by announcing a FOIA request about Under Secretary of War Brad Hansell's flight to Fort Huachuca on September 8 (A-2645.1). She ties that date to Mitch Snow's account of seeing Erika Kirk at a hotel on the base.

lines: - **Artifacts verbally referenced but not shown**: A-2645.1 (the Hansell FOIA request and response). The Daily Mail article on withholding the video and the host's prior-day naming of donors are referenced but not shown. A studio cutout of Laura Loomer holding a long "receipt" (25:19) is a comedy prop and is recorded only as meme context.
- **Episode metadata**: the skeleton's Video Timestamp Range was 00:56:29; it is set to 00:47:48 from the transcript front matter.

- **Name matching**: the host repeatedly says "Pete Buttigieg" (21:34) when she means Pete Hegseth; all are mapped to N-591. "Larry Loomer" is the host's running nickname for Laura Loomer (N-60). "Andrew Kolvet", "Andrew Kovacs" and "Kovacs" are mapped to N-14 Andrew Kolvet. "Brad Hansell" is mapped to N-433 Bradley Hansell. "Prime Minister Rama" is assumed to be Edi Rama (N-664); the transcript gives only the surname. "Admiral Cooper, the commander of CENTCOM" (N-670) is likely Adm. Brad Cooper, but only the surname airs. "Brian knows that" in the Trump Fox and Friends clip is probably Brian Kilmeade, but he is not linked because only the first name airs. "Erika Frantz Paye" in a viewer comment is a variant of Erika Frantzve (N-2). "Nathaniel" and "Nathan Rothschild" are taken as Nat Rothschild (N-663).

- **Transcription ambiguities**: "Cezanne" (13:42) is Sazan; "Karg Island" is Kharg; "trolling at WLS" refers to YWLS; "Sam 702" is linked to N-10611 (SAM702). "in 1950 1959" is a self-correction, and 1959 is used.

- **Possible host errors kept as spoken**: the host says "the Roman name for Pluto is Hades" (Hades is the Greek name); she calls Enver Hoxha "prime minister" (he was also First Secretary); she gives Iran's population as "150 million". C-9865 places the hotel sighting "on the base" on "the 8th"; prior claim C-4347 names the Candlewood Inn & Suites, so the two are consistent.
- **Speaker ambiguity**: in A-2642.1 the transcript does not separate Kolvet's lines from Neff's; C-9849, C-9850 and C-9852 mention both.

- **DIA scan**: the only hit is "candaceowens. com" (42:59) in a merch plug for the Stand With Candace mug, not a tip request, so it is not a DIA beat. No tip, bounty or Decentralized Intelligence Agency beats air.

- **Cross-episode links left out**: C-9853 (video doctored) is close to C-9050 (donors assert the audio was faked) but is the host's own assertion, not the donors', so it is not linked. C-9862 restates Hansell's title (C-9620) but is about the FOIA, so it is not linked. C-9842 (Loomer firearm prohibition) has no matching prior claim.
- Characterizations of the Rothschilds as "openly satanic" and of the Sazan deal as Rothschild "agents" controlling waterways
- The theory that the Iran war aims to add the Strait of Hormuz to "the Rothschild empire"
- "If they don't care about the murder of Charlie Kirk, do you know how quickly they would murder your sons and daughters?"
- The host's paraphrases of officials as wanting to "bomb bridges" and "kill citizens"

- The claim that Israel is "the Khazarian Empire reassembled" and that its people "are not the Jews of the Bible" (a contested theory, not inscribed; C-9859 keeps only the narrow historical assertion)
- The theory that Western publishers suppressed Russian history books after World War II
- The Dexter Morgan viewer comment that Erika Kirk and JD Vance are half siblings fathered by Michael Aquino (A-2643.2 only), which the host calls "pretty far out there"
- The claim that Emmanuel Macron had "the hand of Rothschild upon him" at every turn
- Rhetorical questions on why TPUSA would troll about a dying wish

- **Minor factual beats not inscribed**: the host says the Rothschilds chose Israel's flag (the Seal of Solomon) and excommunicate family members who marry outside the family. She also says the Planet Nine helipad doubles as a basketball court, that her channel reached 6 million subscribers, that customer service replaced a lost Crisis King mug, and that book club is the next day.
- **Sponsor reads** (Pre-Born, Tax Network USA) and merch promotion are excluded.
